masterPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, visual consistency correction.
This is DEPTH AI, one Windows desktop program, not eight independent designs. Preserve the module-first concept and product workflows. Every output must look like another tab of the EXACT SAME application.
CANONICAL DESIGN RULES, do not improvise:
- Full front-facing 16:10 application frame, approximately 1600x1000. Warm off-white shell #F3F1EB, charcoal workspace #242B30, dark ink #273139. No browser chrome, MR environment or physical display.
- Header is exactly 64px tall. At x24 y32 use plain text wordmark 'DEPTH AI' only, no emblem or colorful logo. Next project selector at x220, then one search field, and the same small text-only 'Meta' pill at right. No avatars, no bell, no changing logos.
- Left rail width88px, same six outline symbols with identical stroke weight and same labels/positions on every screen: 지도, 이해, 분리, 통합, 에셋, 검토. Active row has light lavender fill and a narrow indigo marker; other rows are ink on off-white. Main header title baseline y110. Main workspace x104 to1248. Fixed ivory right inspector x1272 to1584, same width312, top y80 and bottom944. Bottom fixed chrome height40, neutral zoom/fit controls bottom-left, tiny 'DESIGN STUDY' bottom-right. Keep these regions stable even when content changes.
- All headings the same restrained Korean sans serif, same 26px H1, 16px module names, 13px secondary text. No oversized promotional slogans; no changing typeface.
- ALL modules are the SAME manufactured component family: front-facing broad rounded rectangle, ONE 10px clipped upper-right corner, 10px other corner radius, shallow 4px bottom lip, fine consistent border, one soft lower-right shadow. Satin, almost matte. No glass, folded-paper corners, octagonal medallions, extra rivets, giant machined bevels or chrome. Larger expanded modules use the same profile and depth; do not scale border/shadow thickness.
- Fixed role colors: coral #F1B7AB = functions/methods; mint #B9DCCB = fields/state/data; lavender #CFC5E8 = type/container/contract/view; sand #E5CB96 = image/file assets. Program, Pricing, Rewards and JobQueue are CLASSES so lavender; their methods are coral. DiscountPercent field is mint. Role colors must NEVER turn green merely to indicate an addition or amber merely because it came from Project B. Change/provenance status uses small chips and borders only.
- Every socket is the same 10px dark center with thin light ring, two-pixel connectors, one arrowhead at DESTINATION. Call=solid coral, reference=dashed lavender, declared view binding=solid mint; selection highlight=indigo. Group containment uses a quiet dotted outline with no arrows. Proposed file movement/reuse uses a separate gray dashed mapping arrow with label. No random bright cable palette.
- All primary actions are the SAME solid indigo #6658D9, 8px radius, height38. Secondary actions outline gray. Amber is caution only, green success only after verification; do not invent success. Selection border is indigo. Same spacing rhythm 8/16/24.
- Same asset art everywhere: a stylized matte clay cylindrical mug, warm cream upper body and muted sage lower third, handle on the RIGHT; matching stylized broad-leaf plant in sage ceramic pot. Plain light neutral backdrop, upper-left soft lighting, tiny grounded shadow. No photographic grain/speckles, no lifestyle bokeh, no props, no mixture of stock photo and flat illustration. Reuse the same mug/plant appearance across thumbnails and large preview. These are illustrative project images, not mesh output.
- Preserve factual names, code snippets and unrun/proposal states from target. Never invent files, code bodies, statistics, percentages or live execution status. Distinguish source graph, illustrative data flow and proposed mapping.
- One full application screen per output. No style guide text, palette swatches, contact sheet or multiple screenshots inside an output.

Preserve the named modules and conceptual features while applying the rules exactly. Remove the extra permanent file-tree column to use the same 88px navigation rail as every other view; file selection is through the top project selector.
Center title '프로젝트 지도', subtitle 'Checkout · 역할과 공유 구현'. On the charcoal workspace, organize roomy module groups: CheckoutController containing the ApplyCoupon method; CouponRules containing CalculateTotal and a mint DiscountPercent field 20; CouponValidator; CartSummary; CartState; TotalsView. Class containers lavender, actual method insets coral, state insets mint. Keep group frames quiet and module profiles consistent, no origami folds. Two callers refer to one shared CouponRules implementation, no duplicate pricing. Include a small asset tray with the canonical matching mug and plant illustrations; use the exact same object designs on all later screens. No invented code; use short Korean purpose labels. Right fixed inspector heading '모듈 정보', a compact selected CouponRules summary, a '소스 기반' chip, a 'Meta 설명 미생성' state, and one indigo 'Meta 분석' button. No standalone giant Meta logo. Left active navigation 지도. Plain wordmark DEPTH AI, no emblem. This output is the master that later images must copy for shell, colors, shapes, icons, assets and button styling. Preserve strong modular visual appeal and readability.
